firm_data.firm_description: Seward & Kissel LLP is a leading U.S. law firm that focuses on corporate and litigation work for clients seeking legal expertise in the financial services, corporate finance, and capital markets areas. The Firm is particularly well known for its representation of major commercial banks, investment banking firms, investment advisers and related investment funds.
notable_facts: Offices in New York City and Washington, D.C.
Focuses on representing clients in financial services, corporate finance and capital markets
